CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2464 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 07db35124d69251ad755baffc61460e833e67d88. Bus nonce: 26509a33afa7ad7987a53f2f3edcf9a6. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 07db35124d69251ad755baffc61460e833e67d88`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 07db35124d69251ad755baffc61460e833e67d88` or `Fix review: blocked 07db35124d69251ad755baffc61460e833e67d88 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 26509a33afa7ad7987a53f2f3edcf9a6`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2464 07db35124d69251ad755baffc61460e833e67d88") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2464-26509a33`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Round 3 of R10-CI-LAYOUT PR 0, at head 07db3512, which merges code dd3a4447 with main. This is the last round before the three-round rule.

Round 2 at c4a357e5 was blocked root-cause-unanswered. fast (3.14) went red because harness_headers.py's CPU-bounded sysid_estimator_frontier check read 306.4 s against 240 s.

The fixer's root cause: R(a) moved arch_score.py into lane_golden, which runs alongside lane_units, where harness_headers.py ran. In the round-2 job, 404 of harness_headers' 411 s overlapped arch_score. The base layout reads 142.5-164.0 CPU-s.

The fix: harness_headers.py runs alone, right after stress.py, in the alone phase. No bound or headroom changed. A new entities check pins it there, with a null on stress.py. New mutant M8 moves it back into lane_units and is caught; the harness reports survivors=0. The body re-takes ## Red checks: fast (3.14) and pr-contract at c4a357e5.

WAIT for this head's CI to conclude, then read the FULL fast log. Its job time grows past this session, so poll at most every 5 min. Confirm or refute:
- (a) sysid_estimator_frontier.py is back within 142.5-164.0 CPU-s. A reading at or above the round-2 value refutes co-running as the cause.
- (b) The 5-minute critical-path saving. The fixer projects about 4.5 min, which misses the bar. Measure it and state which option the body recommends: the A3 fallback for R(a) alone, or keep it and let the post-merge window rule decide.

Also check:
- the round-2 non-blocking notes (window-rule wording, the R10-STAMP carry line);
- that the second R10-CI-LAYOUT carry, which keeps harness_headers.py in the alone phase, is in that group's brief on handoff/audit-r10-roster at 1604c987 (not yet on main);
- every figure, the mutants, and the merge with origin/main.

Say that this is round 3.
